Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 25-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Reinforcement Learning [NPT_4126]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Describe Reinforcement Learning (RL) in your own words and compare it with supervised learning        (2)  
  by highlighting how the learning process differs between the two.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Discuss the difference between supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning with suitable (3)  
  examples.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)           Apply the Temporal Difference (TD(0)) learning concept to a simple Markov chain with three          (5)  
  weather states, Sunny, Cloudy, and Rainy. Define the possible rewards and transition probabilities,  
  and explain how TD(0) would update the estimated value of each state after observing one episode  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                Describe the key components of a Markov Decision Process ?                                            (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                      Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Distinguish between value-based and policy-based reinforcement learning approaches with               (3)  
  suitable examples.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Consider an example of an Markov Decision Process representing a self-driving car at                  (5)  
  intersections. Interpret its states, actions, transition probabilities, and rewards.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Given a small Markov Decision Process , interpret how policy evaluation can be used to update the (2)  
  value of a state after one iteration.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Given a grid-world example, demonstrate one iteration of policy iteration, showing policy             (3)  
  improvement and evaluation steps.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  Page #1

C)               Compare the gradient-based optimization in policy gradient methods with value-based approaches       (5)  
  like Q-learning. What advantages does the former offer?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                       Examine how the λ parameter in TD(λ) influences the trade-off between bias and variance in           (3)  
  learning.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)               Compare linear and non-linear function approximation methods in reinforcement learning,              (3)  
  highlighting their strengths and limitations.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)               Consider a reinforcement learning task with complex, high dimensional states. Examine whether        (4)  
  linear function approximation or neural network-based approximation is more suitable and justify  
  your choice.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                       Demonstrate how an agent can use function approximation (e.g., linear or neural network) to          (3)  
  estimate the value function.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)               Compare POMDPs with standard MDPs, focusing on how uncertainty in observations impacts               (3)  
  decision-making.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)               Apply the concept of policy gradients combined with deep learning to explain how reinforcement       (4)  
  learning can be used in a real-world application such as healthcare or data science. Provide a  
  suitable example to illustrate the implementation.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
